headline: Chittenden County Municipal Legislative Breakfast, which a quorum of councilors may attend.
summary: A quorum may attend a county legislative breakfast. The notice lists no items for council action.
items: Possible attendance by a quorum at the Chittenden County Municipal Legislative Breakfast
location: Delta Hotel, 1117 Williston Road, South Burlington
plain_text:
Notice of Quorum - Winooski City Council
l A quorum of Winooski City Councilors may attend the Chittenden County Municipal 
Legislative Breakfast on Thursday, December 10, 2026, at 7:30 AM at the Delta Hotel (1117 
Williston Road, South Burlington) 
l No official City Council actions will occur; this notice meets the Vermont Open Meeting Law 
requirement
